title: totalWithdrawal Phase-2 executes against LIVE clientBalances, not the Phase-1 snapshot; story-048 retiming (6h wait / 78h total) widens the announce-vs-execute drift window and lets a client's mid-window deposits be swept without a fresh anti-rug wait
severity-proposal: Low (QA / operational-hazard; cross-references potential-medium PATTERN-001 — dedup to reconcile, not a fresh High/Medium)
file:line: src/AYieldStrategy.sol:846-860 (_executeWithdrawal reads state.balance snapshot) -> src/concreteYieldStrategies/ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy.sol:209-240 (_totalWithdraw uses `amount` only for require(amount>0) at L211, then sells shares proportional to LIVE clientBalances[token][client] at L219-220)
description: The two-phase totalWithdrawal anti-rug machine snapshots the client's balance in Phase 1 (_initiateWithdrawal caches state.balance = this.balanceOf(token,client) at AYieldStrategy.sol:826-832 and announces it in WithdrawalInitiated). Phase 2 (_executeWithdrawal, L846-860) forwards that cached value to _totalWithdraw, but the concrete _totalWithdraw consumes `amount` ONLY for the `require(amount > 0)` liveness check (ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy.sol:211). The shares actually sold and the principal actually zeroed are derived from the LIVE state at execution time: sharesToSell = vault.balanceOf(this) * clientBalances[token][client] / totalDeposited[token] (L219-220), and the client is zeroed for its full live clientStoredBalance (L234-235). The Phase-1 snapshot is therefore advisory only; the executed quantity is whatever the client's live principal is when Phase 2 runs. The base mutators of clientBalances (deposit / depositAsOwner / withdraw / relinquishPrincipal) remain open throughout the waiting+execution window (totalWithdrawal does not freeze the client). story-048 makes the divergence horizon materially worse: WAITING_PERIOD shrank 24h->6h (constants at AYieldStrategy.sol:84-86) while TOTAL_DURATION grew 72h->78h, so the interval between the publicly-announced snapshot and the live execution stretched and the community reaction window before any execution is now 4x smaller.
attack-path: 1) Owner calls totalWithdrawal(token, client) Phase 1; WithdrawalInitiated announces balance=X (the community-visible anti-rug commitment per the docstring at AYieldStrategy.sol:415). 2) During the 6h..78h window the authorized client contract (a protocol contract that itself custodies end-user funds, e.g. stable-staker / SYA) takes a fresh deposit, growing clientBalances[token][client] to X+Y. 3) Owner calls totalWithdrawal Phase 2; _totalWithdraw sweeps shares proportional to the LIVE X+Y to owner() and zeroes the client. The freshly-deposited Y is migrated to the owner with NO anti-rug waiting period applied to it and without ever having appeared in the announced figure. The harmed parties are the end-users of the client contract whose just-deposited funds bypassed the protective window, not the client contract or the owner. Conversely a mid-window withdraw/relinquish shrinks the live balance below the announced X (benign no-op direction — overlaps ledger L-13). Executor is onlyOwner (Law 3, non-malicious), so this is a footgun / trust-shift, not an attacker-driven theft: the surprise is that the advertised 'announced amount, after a wait' guarantee silently does not bind the executed amount, and story-048 quietly widened the gap.
relation-to-changed-code: Directly enabled/worsened by story-048 (ad12cb1) retiming of WAITING_PERIOD/EXECUTION_WINDOW/TOTAL_DURATION at AYieldStrategy.sol:84-86. The live-re-read logic in _totalWithdraw is pre-existing, but the diff (a) enlarged the announce-vs-execute drift horizon and (b) shrank the reaction window 4x, turning a latent snapshot/live mismatch into a more reachable one. The stale docstring at AYieldStrategy.sol:414 still claims 24h/48h, so a reader cannot even infer the true window.
relation-to-known/ledger: Reconcile with pattern-matcher PATTERN-001 (TWO-STEP-COMMIT-WINDOW, potential-medium) — same root cause; this entry adds the source-confirmed cross-contract harm dimension (client end-users) and confirms _totalWithdraw line refs. Overlaps ledger carryover L-13 (zero-snapshot) only on the benign shrink direction; the GROW direction + 6h/78h retiming is the diff-relevant angle. NOT the acknowledged M-02 NAV/AMM cluster. Deduplicator should fold CODE-001 + PATTERN-001 into one finding rather than double-count.
